paragraph.text: For a few months now I've been running a Platform Architect mission at CBA alongside the Lead Front-End role: dev platform and agentic AI for the product and tech teams. Right in the thick of it. I'm also wrapping up the RideMyPark rebuild — the old WordPress site rebuilt from scratch in React + Go, coded end to end with AI. A rewrite I'd been putting off for four years, done in a month. No freelance availability right now, my hands are already full.
